statement.p: Find the slope of the line that goes through the points (4,-12) and (14,15).
Enter your answer as an integer or a reduced fraction in the form A/B

ul.li: \displaystyle\frac{{{15}-{\left(-{12}\right)}}}{{{14}-{\left({4}\right)}}}=\frac{{27}}{{10}} which reduces to \displaystyle\frac{{27}}{{10}} (if it's not already reduced)
